comment: Golden fixtures for Phase 5b data-quality gates. EXPECTED values are transcribed from each company's officially filed 10-K figures (assistant training knowledge of the filings, cutoff Jan 2026; FY2025 values cite the specific filed 10-K) — deliberately NOT derived from this project's xbrl_facts pipeline, so the suite tests the pipeline against external ground truth. Every value carries a citation for human verification against EDGAR. Tolerances: dollar figures 1% relative, EPS 1% relative, margins 0.003 absolute.

ttm_revenue.source: AAPL FY2023 10-K (filed 2023-11-03), Consolidated Statements of Operations: total net sales $383,285M

gross_margin.source: AAPL FY2023 10-K: gross margin $169,148M / net sales $383,285M = 44.13%

ttm_eps.source: AAPL FY2024 10-K: diluted EPS $6.08 (includes EU State Aid tax charge)

ttm_revenue.source: NIKE FY2023 10-K (filed 2023-07-20, May fiscal year-end): revenues $51,217M
JPMorgan FY2023 10-K (filed 2024-02-16): total net revenue, reported basis $158,104M (XBRL 'Revenues')
JPMorgan FY2024 10-K (filed 2025-02-14): total net revenue, reported basis $177,556M
Berkshire Hathaway FY2022 10-K (filed 2023-02-27), Consolidated Statements of Earnings: total revenues $302,089M

behavior_fixtures.comment: Expected structural behaviors, asserted from the data (not from truncatable job_runs warning text). A regression that silently 'fixes' any of these wrongly must fail the suite.

dual_class_identical.reason: Same CIK; facts duplicated per share class by design (Phase 4).

eps_proxy_at_latest.assert: ttm_eps present at latest as_of while zero eps_basic/eps_diluted facts exist (proxy = net income / wtd diluted shares)
eps_proxy_at_latest.reason: Multi-class names whose per-class EPS is dimensioned (absent from companyfacts) but share counts exist.

eps_null_no_proxy_possible.assert: ttm_eps absent at latest as_of and zero eps facts (no usable share counts to proxy with)
eps_null_no_proxy_possible.reason: Multi-class cover-page share counts are dimensioned; EPS uses custom extension tags.

roic_roa_proxy.assert: roic present at latest as_of while zero operating_income facts exist (ROA proxy)
roic_roa_proxy.reason: Banks do not report an operating-income subtotal.

revenue_null_flagged.reason: No globally-safe revenue tag (bank/REIT component tagging or tag switch); left null, never forced.

recent_ipo_no_data.assert: zero xbrl_facts, zero fundamental_metrics (no junk data for a no-history IPO)
recent_ipo_no_data.reason: FedEx Freight spinoff with no XBRL history yet; self-heals as it files. The check is that it produced no facts/metrics; an ingester warning is not required (truncation-prone).

recent_ipo_short_history.assert: has metrics at latest as_of but revenue_cagr absent (insufficient annual history)

universe_excludes.reason: Was BRK-A (S&P 500 era). The universe is now broad NYSE/Nasdaq, where BRK-A is a legitimately listed class, so it is no longer asserted absent. Non-operating listings (warrants/units/rights) are handled by is_active hygiene, not row-absence.

point_in_time.comment: Proves restatements do not leak backward: the original filed value must remain the as-known value at early dates.

as_known_early.source: ADM Q1-2024 10-Q (filed 2024-04-30): revenues from contracts with customers as originally presented; the 10-Q/A filed 2024-11-18 re-affirmed this figure

as_known_late.source: ADM Q1-2025 10-Q (filed 2025-05-06): Q1-2024 comparative re-presented (contract-revenue scope narrowed following ADM's restatement saga); verified in xbrl_facts filing chain 2024-04-30 -> 2024-11-18 -> 2025-05-06
